protocol.model: local scripted fixture; no quality/real-model claim

prompts.tools: Read answer.txt, edit answer = 41 to answer = 42, read answer.txt again, then return BENCH_OK.

protocol.cache: fresh workspace/resource dir; OS cache not flushed
protocol.memory: PID/PPID sum RSS sampled every 50ms; wait4 parent rusage separately reported; ps sampler adds overhead
protocol.schema_bytes_method: UTF-8 length of json.dumps(tools, ensure_ascii=False), default separators; re-encoded subset, not original wire body or tokenizer tokens
protocol.resource_isolation: HOME unchanged; Go preflights known personal config/Skills/MCP/hooks/auth/models/commands by metadata only, accepts absent or empty memory, and shadows conventional Skill dir; PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; OpenCode XDG roots/CONFIG_DIR plus official OPENCODE_TEST_HOME isolate compatibility Skills

source.working_tree: uncommitted iteration changes; all Go source manifest hashed separately
source.baseline_method: git archive into separate temporary source tree; same Go compiler/CGO0/flags

make_default_artifact.label: protected Make default; separate from matched CGO0 comparison

pi.node_runtime_footprint: not measured; dynamic launcher binary is not a full Node runtime

limits: loopback scripted provider; no real-model quality/token-cost claim
all Go performance arms use default compatibility profile, extensions/git/tracing disabled; headless denotes tags only, not an edge-profile performance measurement
fixed task semantics; differing default tool sets and presentation features
OpenCode uses a new private standalone server and fresh state each invocation; not a benchmark of an already-running background service
OS caches not flushed; sampled RSS may miss peaks and double count shared pages
process CPU is wait4 child-reported, not an asserted whole-tree CPU sum
render history row counts and stream sizes match, historical body bytes differ; no precise equivalent-UI speed ratio
cross compilation is not target-device runtime validation
pilot1 configuration failure retained in narrative only; calibrated pilot2 all 10 cohorts passed
Go ready latency is shorter than the50ms RSS interval and captures one early sample; do not compare ready tree RSS as complete memory peaks
temporary_data: Task-owned temporary binaries, caches, comparator downloads/installations, raw outputs, workspaces and trust fixtures have been removed. Durable JSON retains parameters, provenance and numeric observations; source worktree is retained for review.
